title: Nunc, Deus, ad requiem (Senfl)
desc: Ludwig Senfl, Nunc, Deus, ad requiem. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Stuttgart 36. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
